dir.script:
declare @deststatus int, @uid int, @dduyet date, @userlogin VARCHAR(32); set @deststatus = case @xstatus when 1 then 5 else 1 end set @uid = case when @xstatus = 1 then @@userId else 0 end set @dduyet = case when @xstatus = 1 then getdate() else null end
select @userlogin = username from vdmnv where user_id_0 = @@userId
update cuochopacp set status = @deststatus, user_id_acp = @uid, ngay_acp = @dduyet where ma_cuochop in (select ma_cuochop from @tblKeys) and ma_nv = @userlogin select '' as message, '$Processed' as toast
&VoucherJSLoading;
